description: This PHP source file defines a class Returns in the Opencart admin controller for managing sale returns, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and handling return history.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD operations and views for sale returns in the Opencart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the list page of returns, setting up page data and loading views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to output the list view, primarily used for AJAX refresh.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of returns based on filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a return record, including validation and database interaction.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of return status changes.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves return history entries with pagination for display.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a return, such as status change comments.
